description: This file defines classes and methods related to merging modules and types in a linker component, including MergeStatus and ModuleMerger classes with various merging functions.

classes.name: MergeStatus
classes.description: Represents the merge status of a type, including whether it was newly added and its type ID.

classes.name: ModuleMerger
classes.description: Handles merging of module IRs, including types, functions, enums, and global variables.

methods.name: MergeGraphs
methods.description: Merges another module IR into the current module.

methods.name: MergeCFunctionLikeDeps
methods.description: Merges dependencies for C function-like IRs.

methods.name: MergeRecordAndDependencies
methods.description: Merges record types and their dependencies.

methods.name: MergeRecordCXXBases
methods.description: Merges C++ base classes for record types.

methods.name: MergeRecordTemplateElements
methods.description: Merges template elements of record types.

methods.name: MergeReferencingTypeInternalAndUpdateParent
methods.description: Merges referencing types and updates parent types accordingly.

methods.name: MergeReferencingTypeInternal
methods.description: Handles internal merging of referencing types.

methods.name: UpdateUDTypeAccounting
methods.description: Updates user-defined type accounting during merge.

methods.name: LookupUserDefinedType
methods.description: Looks up user-defined types by unique ID.

methods.name: LookupType
methods.description: Looks up types in the module.
